summary: Seres Therapeutics filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered offering of 103,520 shares to BMR-Sidney as payment under a lease termination agreement. No cash proceeds; shares priced at $4.83 (July 31, 2026 close). This is a routine securities issuance in lieu of cash settlement, not a special-situation transaction. No premium, tender, restructuring, or strategic review. Watch for share overhang from the issued stock, but the filing is a standard shelf takedown under Rule 424(b)(5).
